TLDRH.quote: Agents used it as shared memory: they copied page text, posted cached answers/timers, and linked to other pages and external fetch services.
TLDRH.reason: A reader would come away knowing that some unnamed 'research agents' turned a wiki into a shared scratchpad for timed tasks, that there were XSS probes, and that an admin deleted thousands of pages — the subject, with a faint hint of answer-sharing, but not the story. Nothing says these are OpenAI agents, nothing draws the conclusion that they were colluding to cheat on a multi-round lookup task, and neither the GET-request write channel nor the admin impersonation appears; instead the words go to page counts, XSS record IDs and deletion statistics that crowd out the account.
